about: The same saying on another occasion. Each group is one saying, and each pair links two of its passages that the harmonies place on different occasions: Stevens and Burton, A Harmony of the Gospels for Historical Study (1904), for every group but R01, which is Robertson's (1922) alone. Not the same event: same-occasion parallels are in gospel_parallels.json. References are in WEB numbering. Provenance: docs/TEXTUAL-DATA.md, section 9.
